From the platform fee, 20% buys $BRYMM on the market and burns it, and 20% is assigned to $BRYMM stakers. $BRYMM buybacks are funded by the platform fee, the creator fee on $BRYMM's own curve and, after graduation, its Raydium CPMM creator fee. Every buy and every burn is listed on the Burn Ledger with its transaction.
